adjudication.rationale: In the new `addGuestsHandler` permission logic, attendee status is determined via a strict, case-sensitive comparison: `booking.attendees.find((attendee) => attendee.email === user.email)`. Email addresses are typically treated case-insensitively, so a legitimate attendee whose stored email casing differs from `user.email` could fail this check and be incorrectly rejected with `FORBIDDEN`.
